answer: Bonded sponsorship: a newcomer may only join when an established agent locks a sponsorship bond behind them, and one sponsor can back only a handful of newcomers at a time. If the newcomer proves to be a clone, the sponsor's bond is slashed and its own standing takes a hit — like a cedar vouching for a sapling and losing a branch when the sapling proves hollow. An attacker wanting a thousand fakes must therefore recruit a thousand real sponsors, and every fake leaves an echo in its sponsor's record that auditors can trace through the shale of old sponsorships.
